polaris: LP29-C2T / provenance-complete external joined table construction
framework: Executable witness payload contract for a row audit automaton. Round 4 replaces reviewer-readable BLOCK/WARN/PASS labels with payload-derived gate decisions over same-sample crosswalk, graph convention lock, external label independence, forbidden-control audit, and applicable Srivastava OI reproduction.
math_object: A typed decision function D(payload) over finite gate predicates: gate_status_i = f_i(witness_fields_i); row_decision = BLOCK if any required gate is BLOCK, WARN if no required gate is BLOCK and at least one required gate is WARN, PASS only if all required gates PASS. material_validation_allowed = true only when row_decision = PASS and all joined-table blockers are cleared.

findings.finding: Round 4 emits a JSON Schema for witness payloads. The schema requires row_id, candidate_source, required joined-field witness block, same_sample_crosswalk, graph_convention_lock, external_label_independence, forbidden_control_row_audit, OI_Srivastava_reproduction, and executor_contract.

Round 4 emits five example JSONL witness payloads linked to C2T-AUDIT-0001 through C2T-AUDIT-0005. Each payload carries missing fields, contradictions, witness arrays, and machine_reviewable evidence flags sufficient for an executor to derive current BLOCK outcomes.

Round 4 emits gate predicates as CSV. These predicates define PASS/WARN/BLOCK transitions for required_joined_fields_presence, same_sample_crosswalk, graph_convention_lock, external_label_independence, forbidden_control_row_audit, OI_Srivastava_reproduction, row_decision, and material_validation_allowed.
Expected executor results preserve the Round 3 boundary: all five current candidate rows remain BLOCK and material_validation_allowed=false.

strangest_prediction.prediction: A future row will look complete in the joined table and still be executor-BLOCK because its graph convention protocol timestamp is after label access or because its same-sample identity is only a material-name join.
strangest_prediction.testable_consequence: Running the gate predicates against witness payloads will reject plausible-looking rows even when all user-facing schema columns are nonempty.

a_objection: A will likely object that this is still bookkeeping rather than physics. The reply is that C2T's claimed physical comparison is forbidden until the row identity, graph protocol, label independence, and forbidden-control witnesses are executable. This round makes that prohibition reproducible.

reviewer_response.round3_fatal_point: Round 3 had blocker-status CSV but no executable witness payload schema, making BLOCK/WARN/PASS manual labels.
reviewer_response.round4_response: Added witness payload schema, five JSONL payload examples, deterministic gate predicates, and executor expected results. The executor can recompute status from missing_fields, contradictions, machine_reviewable witnesses, and specific gate fields.
reviewer_response.pass_transition_summary: A row can become PASS only when required joined fields have machine-reviewable provenance, same_sample_crosswalk proves a pre-label same-sample identity, graph_convention_lock proves pre-label L_sym/cutoff/rho/attack controls on the same graph, external_label_independence proves non-synthetic external labels, forbidden_control_row_audit passes all applicable subchecks, and any claimed OI reproduction has exact formula/code, normalization, and same-structure mapping.
